newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products all firm, gas oil strongest.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all firm, gas oil strongest.

text.p: NWE oil products all firmed on Tuesday, largely following futures gains, but only the gas oil market was fundamentally strong, dealers said.

Heating oil barges were up between $3 and $4 as IPE futures firmed. The market remained tight. However, the gains deterred buyers and forced sellers to lower their offers by 50 cents to IPE Oct +$9/+$10 fob ARA. Second half deliveries were offered at +$6.50 fob ARA.
Gasoline ticked up $1 a tonne after the NYMEX gasoline contract recovered in out-of-hours trading. But prompt barges were still very poorly bid.
A prompt Eurograde barge traded at $199 fob ARA and an early October vessel sold for $200.50 fob Antwerp. Traders said the weak prompt price was testiment to the absence of bids.
"There's barely anyone really wanting prompt at the moment," one trader said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges edged up after initial weakness. Two lots traded at $109.00 and $109.50 fob ARA, the buyer the same for both deals. Bunker demand was lacklustre with early signs of about 6-7,000 tonnes.
